title: Nixon-Haldeman Smoking Gun tape

tellings.quote: whole Smoking Gun when you look at the Smoking Gun conversation on the 21st of June that with halman uh in Nixon on the tapes that uh that halderman comes into the office and says uh Mr President I think we've got a problem here

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer and researcher speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, points to a 1972 recording made secretly in the White House, known as the "Smoking Gun" conversation. He says that on the tape, dated by him to June 21, Richard Nixon's close aide H.R. Haldeman walks into the president's office and says, "Mr President, I think we've got a problem here." Sheehan treats the tape as a key piece of evidence for the larger hidden story he tells about the people around Nixon.
